note: Changes to the Citizens VCRM demo, newest first, from the demo's change log. Dates are when each change was made on the preview; most went live the same day.

changes.change: Preview only, using more of xAI's voice features: a dropped line or Carry on picks up the same conversation on xAI (kept 30 minutes, tool calls included) instead of a summary; the speech recognizer is told to listen for US English and up to 100 key words (contact names, entities, stages); Ara says C.A. as Citizens Alliance and PAC as pack; the hands-free line is spoken word for word by xAI, then Ara carries on (if xAI doesn't play it, Ara says it).

Preview only: on a computer screen the call bar's background band no longer covers the mic at the top of the left menu during a conversation, and in spooky mode the cobwebs sit in the top corners of the page instead of floating in the middle.
Preview only: the rolling pumpkin plays the opening of Bach's Toccata and Fugue in D minor (the first 7 seconds of the recording Carverhill sent) as it crosses the screen. It used to be silent.
Preview only: the owl now hoots with a real owl recording (from tunetank.com) instead of the phone-made hoot, both the owl that comes by in spooky mode and the "Tap me to hear me hoot!" owl.

Preview only: turning hands-free on or off mid-form, Ara now says "Hands-free is on. I'll read back all the information on the form and save it when you say yes." and then carries straight on with the form's next question (she used to stop and wait). A mic the phone mutes for a moment no longer ends the call; it waits up to 6 seconds for it to come back.

Fixes from a test call: when the iPhone briefly pauses the app's sound (a notification, Siri, another app) the call stays open for up to 6 seconds while the sound comes back, instead of ending; hands-free stays on after Carry on; if Ara talks past a tapped save the app tells her again; every interaction report asks whether it was substantive and the read-back says so; marking a saved report substantive needs a next step and its due date (creates a task); "it's J B" in an email is no longer read as S J B; in the optional questions the officer can go back to a question, an entity named at the amount question goes to the entity, Ara no longer reads the app's instructions aloud and can't jump to the read-back early; after a Carry on Ara never says something on the open form is saved.

Preview only: after a save Ara says in a few words that it's saved (no more "Saved: task saved"), mentions undo only after the first hands-free save of a conversation, and ends by offering the next step ("Next is to record the ask. Want to do that now?") or asking "What's next?". She no longer asks whether to stop.

Preview only: on a computer screen (1000 pixels or wider) the tab bar becomes a left menu with the mic on top, Home shows Needs attention in a wide left column with the other panels on the right, and Opportunities shows the list beside the open opportunity. Phones are unchanged.

Behind the scenes: the code that keeps the voice line alive (reconnects, line tests, stall and quiet detection, asking Ara again) now lives in one place, with all its timings listed together. Nothing changes in how the app behaves.

Faster recovery on a bad line: if Ara hasn't started replying after 4 seconds, the app tests the line then and opens a fresh one if it is slow (it used to wait 13 seconds). If a new line hasn't opened after 5 seconds, a second one is tried alongside and the first to open is kept. After a reconnect Ara says sorry with no Halloween or Christmas aside and asks only the one question still pending. She passes a question to the project team after any yes, can see opportunities closed this year, and hands-free read-backs say "Summary: noted" instead of reading the summary out.

If the officer talks while the line is down, Ara asks them to say it again once she's back, instead of carrying on as if nothing was said. After a reconnect she answers "Are you there?" with a quick yes and carries on with the open form, without "welcome back" or "what would you like to do" (seen at 6:04 PM).

Tuned from the 5:52 PM drive: when Ara doesn't answer, the app tests the line first and on a slow line opens a fresh one right away instead of asking again (re-asks had piled up six late "I'm here"s); on a healthy line it asks once more, then opens a fresh line. A soft tick plays every 4 seconds while Ara is slow or the line is reconnecting. A new voice pass is fetched as soon as one is used, so a second drop reconnects fast (one took 15 s). Ara's instructions list the entities by state so she can't invent one (she offered a Pennsylvania Fed PAC, which doesn't exist).

More resilience from the 5:30 PM drive: a slow connection test no longer triggers a reconnect while the voice service is still sending (that caused an unneeded drop and 'Did you hear me?'); the quiet hang-up waits 30 seconds in hands-free mode, doesn't start while the officer's voice is on the mic, and is called off if the officer answers as it starts (Ara had said goodbye over 'October 24th'). A new opportunity whose entity has a state campaign always asks National or the state before the read-back.

Recovery for two more cases seen on a drive: a drop right after a hands-free save now tells Ara the save went through (she had tried to save again and said the form closed without saving), and a line that goes dead without closing is caught: if the officer is talking and nothing comes back for 5 seconds, or 12 seconds pass in quiet, the app tests the connection and reconnects instead of hanging up. Reconnect tries are spread over about 15 seconds, wait up to 15 seconds for the phone to come back online, and a line that doesn't open in 10 seconds counts as a failed try.

Steadier voice on a weak connection: a voice pass is kept ready during a call so a dropped line reconnects in a second or two; when Ara is slow a soft tick plays after 4 seconds and the app only asks again at 10 seconds; if she then answers twice, the second answer is cut off; each connection reading times a tiny test request. An ask answered with a check in hand or a yes saves as Accepted, and the ask's Response starts blank so Ara must ask.

When the voice line drops mid-conversation (for example while driving), the app reconnects up to 3 times and Ara picks up where she left off, repeating her last question. When Ara goes silent the app asks her up to 3 more times, then reconnects. If nothing works, the phone plays a short falling tone and says the voice service isn't answering, and the form stays open. Connection readings (online or offline, network type and speed where the phone reports them, time since the voice service last answered) and the reason each call ended now go in the activity log. A planned ask for an entity with a state campaign leaves Campaign blank so Ara asks for it.

When Ara goes silent after the app asks her to speak (no reply, or an empty or failed one), the app asks her once more instead of leaving the officer in silence until the 12-second hang-up. Silent replies and voice service errors now go in the activity log.

Ara understands entities said loosely ("the C-3", "Idaho PAC") and asks which one when it could be several; amounts in words ("one hundred thousand") are understood; a new opportunity now has a campaign of interest, asked when the entity has a state campaign (otherwise National is filled in) and carried to the planned ask.
Tidy-up with no change in behaviour: Ara's voice code split into three files, old screenshots and an unused logo removed, Settings wording for Christmas mode updated, owl test made sturdier.
Opportunity record shows one next-step button: Move to Cultivation once every Qualification step is done, otherwise Log interaction (it used to show both).
Check your hands-free saves: each save now starts with the person's name, e.g. "Ruth Abernathy's capacity rated B" or "Ruth Abernathy: Moved to Cultivation".
Christmas mode now has a white background, with evergreen, Christmas red and gold touches (was a dark evergreen night).
Fix links on Check your hands-free saves now name who or what they are for, e.g. "Edit Ruth Abernathy's contact" or "Open the opportunity: Vasquez, Elena - 2026".
After opening a fix link from Check your hands-free saves, Back (or closing or saving the form) returns to the check list.
Christmas mode can now be turned on any time (Settings, or say "Christmas mode"), not just in December. The Christmas visitors on their own still start December 1.
Check your hands-free saves: each save now has a link to fix it (Edit the contact, Edit the report, Edit the task, Edit the planned ask, or Open the opportunity).
Christmas mode: Santa's "Merry Christmas, ho ho ho" is now a real recording, replacing the computer voice.
Christmas mode: real sleigh bells (a recording) now play for the sleigh, reindeer, gifts and opening forms, replacing the made-up bell sound.

Interaction reports by voice: when Ara never sends the summary, the app now takes it from what the officer said when she asked what was talked about. A next-step due date that is really the meeting date is dropped. Answering "neither" to Ally or Do Not Contact no longer ticks both. The hands-free read-back no longer says ". ." when a form has nothing else to read.

Christmas mode sounds (preview): Santa now says "Ho, ho, hoooo! Merry Christmas!" in a natural voice, and the sleigh, reindeer, gifts and forms opening use fuller sleigh bell sounds. The old phone-made "ho ho ho", which sounded like an owl, is gone.

Christmas mode (try it on the preview now; in the app it is for December): say "Christmas mode" or use Settings. An evergreen look with snow along the header, pine trees, a wreath by the logo and a nativity scene on Home; snow, gifts, elves, reindeer, Santa's sleigh and a Christmas tree come by with their sounds; Santa asks for a tap so sounds can play; sleigh bells as a form opens, a chime on Save, Joy to the World and Santa's "ho ho ho" on Closed Won; Ara becomes a warm Christmas host. Only one of spooky mode and Christmas mode is on at a time.

Phones with Reduce Motion turned on now get the Halloween visitors and their sounds too (they fade in and out in one spot instead of moving across). Before, Reduce Motion hid them all, along with the tap-me owl.

In spooky mode Ara starts every conversation as the haunted-house host: "Mwahaha... welcome to the haunted CRM. Hi Dana, I'm Ara, what would you like to do?" After Carry on she says "Welcome back to the haunted CRM".
The Halloween owl now pops up every time the app opens until someone taps, since sounds stay silent until a tap. Before, he showed only once per phone.

First time the app opens in October, a big owl pops up saying "Tap me to hear me hoot!" so people know to touch the screen to turn on the Halloween sounds. It hoots when tapped and flies away. Shown once per phone.

Optional fields one at a time (preview): after a new contact's or new opportunity's required details, Ara asks "Would you like to add more details? I can take you through them one at a time." The app then leads, one question each, and fills in each answer itself. For a contact: capacity rating (with the bands), how you met, texting permitted (only with a mobile) and how they agreed, then Ally or Do Not Contact ("most people are neither"). For an opportunity: entity, potential amount, notes. Say "skip" or "that's enough" at any point. Also fixed: texting permitted said by voice now reaches a new contact's form.

Fix (preview): on iPhones, tapping during a conversation woke the Halloween sound engine, which could pause Ara's audio or mute the mic and end the conversation; it now rests during conversations. After Carry on, Ara no longer turns spooky mode on a second time and announces it again.

Fix (preview): Halloween sounds play on iPhones again. The sound engine starts on the tap events an iPhone accepts and plays a silent blip, as at 7:27 AM, still without changing the phone's audio mode, so Ara stays audible.
Spooky mode (preview): an owl now visits too. It glides down to a perch near the top, blinks, hoots "hoo, hoo-hoooo" and flies off.

Fix (preview), second try: the page no longer changes the iPhone's audio mode at all, as before 7:27 AM, so Ara can be heard again. Halloween sounds may now be silent when the phone's silent switch is on.

Fix (preview): Ara's voice was silent on iPhones since the Halloween sound fix at 7:27 AM, because the page asked the phone for plain playback. A conversation now asks for talk-and-listen audio, and the app goes back to normal when it ends.

Spooky mode (preview): say "spooky mode" to Ara, or tick it in Settings, for a night look (orange and purple, cobwebs, a flickering candle by the logo), Ara as a slightly slower haunted-house host with spooky asides (facts and save rules unchanged), a creaking door when a form opens, thunder on Save, an organ sting and a cackle with bats on Closed Won, and a visitor every 15 to 20 seconds, now with bats. "Normal mode" turns it off; it ends by itself on Nov 1. Sounds never play during a conversation.
The + button and Settings swapped places: + now sits in the top-right corner, the easiest spot to reach with your thumb and where iPhone apps put their add button, with Settings just to its left.
The pumpkin now plays a short haunted-house organ sting (dun, dun, DUNNN) as it rolls in, instead of thumps.

Fix: the ghost's "wooo" was too low for a phone speaker, so it couldn't be heard. It is now higher, a little longer and starts as the ghost fades in. The pumpkin's thumps are higher too, with a hollow knock.

Fix: Halloween sounds on iPhone. The sounds now play with the silent switch on (only while a sound plays, and never near a conversation), and the sound engine wakes up again after the app has been in the background.

Halloween sounds: the ghost goes "wooo", the spider creaks and scuttles, and the pumpkin thumps as it rolls. The sounds are made by the phone, play quietly only after the first tap and never during a conversation with Ara, and the Halloween switch in Settings turns them off with the visitors.

Two fixes found while writing the tester guide: Ara no longer says the year of a past gift twice ("Oct 2, 2025 2025"), and a defer reason ending in a full stop no longer shows two full stops in History.

The demo is now called a proof of concept everywhere people see or hear it: on screen, in the privacy notice, in Settings and in what Ara says. Questions Ara can't answer now go to the project team. The web address stays the same.

Halloween: during October, every minute or so a spider drops in on its thread, a pumpkin rolls along the bottom, or a ghost floats across. They never get in the way of a tap, and Settings has a switch to turn them off. They stop on their own on November 1.

More tidying with nothing changing on screen: each of Ara's lookup and app tools now has its own small function instead of one long one, eight old unused files were removed, and the logo image went from 52 KB to 9 KB.

Repeated code was removed: 36 copies of the same snippets (form fields, the capacity rating list, opportunity amounts and buttons, help popup close buttons and more) now come from 12 shared pieces. Nothing on screen changes; a fix in one place now applies everywhere.

The demo's one large file was split into a short page plus a styles file and six code files by topic (lists and saved data, forms, the conversation with Ara, screens, the process guide, start-up). Nothing on screen changes; each part is now easier to find and change.

The data saved on each phone now carries a version number. When the demo is updated, a phone upgrades its saved contacts, opportunities and settings one step at a time from its own version, so phones that haven't opened the demo in a while keep working.

Ara gets her full instructions once per call. After a save or a change of screen she now gets a short "Right now" note instead of all the instructions again; they are only resent when her rules change, such as turning hands-free on.

Ara's instructions were tidied: grouped by topic, with repeated rules merged, and cut from about 55,000 to about 16,000 characters so she starts faster. The Process FAQ is no longer sent whole; Ara looks the answer up when asked a process question.

Opportunities and Tasks now have a search box and filter chips like Contacts. Opportunities: Open, Needs attention, Asks this quarter, Pledges to record, Closed this year (on List and Board). Tasks: Open, Overdue, This week, Waiting, Done (Done replaces the separate Done panel). The chip you pick is remembered, and Ara can open a view when asked, such as "show pledges to record" or "show my waiting tasks".

Hands-free fixes: Ara now says only the read-back (she had been reading her own instructions aloud), an answer like "I don't think you needed to say that, but yes, save it" counts as a yes, and after an unclear answer a plain "save it" saves without another read-back. The read-back no longer lists Email and Calls permitted, which are on by default.

New hands-free (driving) mode. Say "I'm driving" or "hands-free mode", or tap Hands-free on the call bar, and Ara can save a finished form for you: she reads it back and saves only after you say yes, and a gift or pledge needs a second yes on the amount. Say "undo" to take back the last save. Hands-free saves are marked in History and listed in Needs attention for checking. Saying "I've parked" or ending the call turns it off. Scheduling a meeting still needs a tap.

The field mics in Summary and Next step have been removed, because the wait before they started listening was too long. The Next step box stays three lines tall. "Fill this in by voice" at the top of the form and the phone keyboard's own mic still work.

The New opportunity form no longer has a "Then move to Cultivation" checkbox. When a contact already has a rating and a substantive interaction, the new opportunity's Next block offers Move to Cultivation? (move, or defer with a reason) right away.
The Next step field on the Interaction report and the Record the ask report is now a three-line box, so a longer next step shows in full.

Field mics on the Interaction report and the Record the ask report. A small mic inside the Summary and Next step fields lets you dictate just that field. Your words appear as you speak. Tap the mic again, or pause, to finish. Ara then tidies the punctuation and name spelling without speaking, and for Next step she also fills in the due date you said. A second dictation adds to the text. "Fill this in by voice" stays at the top. Nothing is saved until you tap Save.

"Next" appears once per record. The What's next card is gone. The Contact and Opportunity records each have one Next block (the Next: line and the next-step buttons, under the stepper). After a save it shows "✓ Planned ask saved" (or whatever was saved) and briefly highlights. The checklist panels below explain what's needed and no longer say Next: "To reach Cultivation" (and so on) on the opportunity, and "To create an opportunity" on the contact (was Path to opportunity).

One guided path from contact to Closed Won. The What's next card, the contact record and the opportunity record now follow one next-step rule. For a new contact that is: set a capacity rating, then create the opportunity, then the opportunity's own steps. The contact record has the same dot stepper (starting at Contact) with a Next: line. The blue button under "Do something" is always the next step, and Path to opportunity marks the next to-do with an arrow. The card's Set capacity rating button opens the rating choices, and after a rating the card offers Create opportunity.

Guided flow. After saving an opportunity step (and a new contact), a "What's next" card at the top of the screen says what was saved and the next step, with a button that opens that form and a Not now button. The opportunity record's stage bar is now a stepper with dots (done, current, still to come) and a "Next:" line just above the stage button.

Permission source is now "Texting permission source" and shows on the New contact and Edit contact forms only while Texting permitted is ticked (it appears as soon as the box is ticked). The contact record shows it only when texting is on. Ara asks for it only after texting is turned on.

Needs attention on Home has filter chips with counts (All, Overdue, Opportunities, Tasks, Contacts; the phone remembers the choice), puts the most urgent first (overdue, then waiting too long, then ready to move), and under All groups items into Overdue, Move an opportunity forward, Tasks this week and Ready for an opportunity, five each with Show all. The old limit of three tasks is gone. Ara can filter it: "What's overdue?", "Show only my tasks".
The "From first contact to Closed Won" overview panel is always last on Home (it used to sit at the top until heard once).
Record the ask's pick list (+ menu) shows planned asks (Ask Planning) in their own section first, then other opportunities, each section A to Z by last name.
The + menu's pick lists (who is it for, which opportunity) always have a search box at the top, are sorted A to Z by last name, and show names as Last, First. Searching "ken ito" finds Ito, Ken.

A yes (Accepted or an agreed counter) to an outright ask now moves the opportunity straight to Commitment: it shows Agreed, gift to follow, a Commitment panel and a Follow up on agreed gift task, and Record gift closes it as Closed Won. A pledge ask still waits in Ask Made until Record pledge enters the pledge with its schedule.

One money button: Record payment is gone and Record gift covers all money in. In Ask Made, a gift with no pledge is recorded as an implied commitment (the opportunity passes through Commitment and closes Closed Won; the screen shows a Commitment panel marked Implied and a Committed tile). In Commitment, Record gift is applied to the pledge. Ask Made now shows Record gift beside Record pledge, and Ara uses one gift tool.
Confetti and balloons now also play when an outright gift is recorded (Record gift), not only a pledge payment, whether the form was typed or filled by voice.

Fix: the Interaction report's Capacity rating now shows the contact's saved rating (it showed empty, so a new contact rated on the New contact form looked unrated). Saving a report with the rating unchanged no longer logs it again in History.
Every form now shows all its fields. The "More details" fold that hid optional fields is gone from all forms (it had already been removed from New contact and New opportunity on Oct 22).

Ending a conversation while a form is open now brings back the voice button on every form, keeping what was filled in. It reads "Continue by voice" once anything was filled by voice, and Ara picks up from what is already on the form (saying "start over" clears it). The voice button also disappears as soon as a conversation starts.

The + menu's Record the ask list now says why each opportunity is there, Ask Planning first: "Ask Planning · planned for (date)", "Ask Made · record the answer" (the investor's response to an ask already made) and "Cultivation · unplanned ask" (the guide lets an unplanned ask be recorded; it passes through Ask Planning in the same save).

Top bar rearranged so titles no longer run into the + button: on Contacts, Opportunities and Tasks your initials are on the far left (tap them to change your name), the title is centred, and the + and the gear are on the right. Home shows your name, the logo, the + and the gear. Screens with a Back button show Back, the title, the + and the gear.

A + button at the top right of every main screen opens one menu to log a meeting or call, schedule a meeting, add a task, add a contact, create an opportunity, plan or record an ask, or record a pledge, gift or payment. On a contact or opportunity it is for that contact (with a Someone else option); elsewhere it asks which contact first, with a search box when the list is long.
Ara can answer questions about the demo itself (what's new, when or why something changed) from this change log. When she can't answer something, she offers to pass the question to the demo team.

Fix: when planning an ask, the form already had the opportunity's entity but Ara asked for it again. Ara is now told what is already on every form, including values from earlier steps, and never asks for them again. New test with the same steps (41 checks).

Ara has a friendly, upbeat, lightly playful personality with varied wording: short reactions to wins (accepted ask, good meeting, gift, payment), sympathy for a declined ask, warmer goodbyes. No jokes about investors, money, flags or mistakes; word-for-word lines stay exact.
After Record pledge, Ara opens with a short congratulation ("Congrats!", "Nice job!" or "Well done!", varied) before saying she saw the save. New test (40 checks).

Ara says out loud that she saw each save, even if the officer has started talking, and keeps a list of what was saved in the conversation so she can answer "did it save?". Recording a payment on a pledge sets off confetti and balloons across the screen. New test (39 checks).

New contact and new opportunity forms show every field (no More details button). By voice, Ara asks once on a new opportunity whether the officer has enough information yet to add the entity of interest, a potential amount and notes. New test (38 checks).

Cancel and start over now work when said in everyday words ("let's cancel this contact", "I don't want to do this anymore", "clear my screen", "cancel this and start a new one"). Ara can close or clear a form herself when the app misses the words, never says a form closed unless it did, and lists the voice commands when asked what she understands. New test with those phrasings.

Activity log records what is in each form when Save is tapped (every filled field, marked "by voice" where Ara filled it); activity page labels it "Form saved". Privacy notice updated; phones that accepted the old notice see a one-time note. Tester guide and its Word copy updated. Test bot 36 of 36.

Shorter greeting: "Hi [first name], I'm Ara, what would you like to do?" at the start of every conversation and after a name is entered; with no name yet, "Hi, I'm Ara, what's your first name?". The list of things Ara can do is read only if asked.

Saved meetings (interaction reports), tasks (wording and due date) and planned asks can be edited, by tapping Edit or by voice. Changes go in History; a planned ask's reminder task moves with its date. Recorded asks, pledges, gifts and payments stay locked: the Pledge panel says only the Chief Gift Officer or an administrator corrects them, and Ara explains this. Test bot 35 of 35.

Ara can read every field on a contact (email, mobile, permissions, Ally, Do Not Contact, how we met, rating) and on an opportunity (stage, potential, entity, each ask with planned date and status, pledge, payments, gift, close reason). Each field says who can change it per the guide; for fields only the system or the Chief Gift Officer can change, Ara explains the rule and offers the proper action instead. Test bot 34 of 34.

A rating given by voice while the contact's Edit form is open now goes on the form and saves with Save changes. Before, it was saved behind the form, so the form kept showing (and could save back) the old rating. Test bot 33 of 33.

Voice commands carried out by the app: cancel, undo, go back, start over, say that again. Spelling accepts "K as in kite" and NATO words. A rating said in words ("donates a million dollars a year") is no longer dropped. Replay tests from real sessions (names changed). Test bot 32 of 32.

Ara reads the officer's first name back, spelled, and saves it only when confirmed; tapping the name in the Home header opens it in Settings. "How do I add a contact" (and similar) starts the task instead of the process tour. A spelled-out name that Ara's update missed is sent back to her to apply; she offers to update the email when a name's spelling changes. Test bot 30 of 30.

Cloudflare Worker now deploys automatically from GitHub whenever its code changes (Deploy Worker workflow, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN secret). First deploy succeeded; secrets and the activity database are kept.

Activity log records each time the app is opened (or reopened after 30 minutes away); privacy notice says so. Activity page gets a "Today: N devices" table with first and last seen and location (needs Worker redeploy).
Test bot checks the live page only with the checks from its last go-live, so preview pushes no longer send false failure emails.

Contacts can be edited: Edit button (top right of the contact record) opens the contact form filled in, with Save changes; by voice, Ara opens the same form with just the changes (show_contact_edit_draft). Each changed field goes to History with old and new value, who and when. Still needs an email or mobile. Do Not Contact stays locked on for a gift officer (only the CGO can turn it off); Ally - Do Not Solicit is locked on unless you set it. Test bot check added (28).

Activity log now records taps (what was tapped and on which screen or form, plus menu and switch choices; never text typed into a field) and touch saves, also outside voice conversations (grouped into visits, new after 30 quiet minutes). Privacy notice in Settings and the name pop-up now says "and what you tap"; first-screen line says "Conversations and taps are saved". Worker code in the repo labels these "Tapped" (optional redeploy; without it they show as "tap"). Test bot check added (27).

Fix: a capacity rating from Ara (new contact or interaction report) is kept only if the officer's last few spoken lines mention a rating, a dollar amount, or just a letter ("C"). Otherwise the field stays "No rating set" and the dropped guess is noted in the Voice log. Test bot updated (26).

Fix: Ara can set the capacity rating while adding a contact. The rating is accepted whenever the officer names it (not only after the optional-details question), in any wording ("C", "C · $25k to $100k", or a dollar amount like $150,000, which becomes B). If Ara uses her rating tool while the New contact form is open, the rating goes on that form. Test bot check added (26).

Fix: dates from voice in any common form ("December 1", "12/1/2026", "2026-12-1", "tomorrow") now fill date fields, including the planned ask date; a date sent under another field name is used; if a date can't be read, Ara is told to resend it. Applies to every voice form. Test bot check added (25).

Fix: an interaction report keeps the spoken summary even when the voice model sends it under another field name (such as notes); Ara is told to put the officer's words in the summary while it is still missing; stray fields are noted in the Voice log. Test bot check added (24).

Cultivation stage button renamed "+ Add planned ask"; form titled "Add planned ask" with a "Save planned ask" button; Next step says "Add a planned ask"; Asks panel shows a blue Planned label; list and board say "Planned ask $X" instead of "Ask $X"; FAQ and stage help updated. Guide wording change for cascade ("Add ask" -> "Add planned ask").

Entity list replaced with 11 entities (Citizens Alliance C3; C.A. of America Action C4; C.A. Fed PAC; C.A. Idaho C4; C.A. Idaho PAC; C.A. North Dakota C4; C.A. North Dakota State PAC; C.A. North Dakota Fed PAC; C.A. New Hampshire C4; C.A. Pennsylvania C4; C.A. Pennsylvania State PAC). Old C3/C4/PAC entities removed. Campaign choices follow the entity: National, plus the entity's own state. "General / no campaign" removed (National used instead). Existing records moved to the new names. Ara checks the pairing. Guide, FDM and other documents to update at cascade.

Opportunity record has a Next step panel under the stage bar showing what moves it to the next stage (Qualification: rating, substantive interaction, officer confirms; later stages: plan the ask, record the ask, record the answer, record the pledge, record the first payment), amber when late. Opportunities list shows a "Next:" line per row; Board unchanged. Ara can say what's next for an opportunity. Guide change for cascade.

New contact form: capacity rating shows "No rating set" until one is chosen. Ara no longer asks a separate rating question: the capacity rating is first in the optional-details list, explained as needed before an opportunity. The app ignores a rating Ara sends before that question, so she can't fill one in by guessing.

Opportunity readiness went live: Ara offers a capacity rating on new contacts (optional); Create opportunity blocked until the contact is ready, with a checklist; Ready for opportunity / Needs rating alerts on the list; Path to opportunity panel on the record; For opportunity markers on the form; Needs attention item; Contacts filter chips; Ara can set a rating. Test bot 21 of 21 on the live page. Guide change for cascade: rating required to create an opportunity.

Home Needs attention lists each contact who is Ready for opportunity ("Jim meets every requirement. Create an opportunity?"). Contacts screen has filter chips: All, Ready for opportunity, Needs rating (with counts). Ara knows which contacts are ready.

Contacts with no open opportunity get one alert on the list: green Ready for opportunity, amber Needs rating, or grey Ally / Do Not Contact. Contact record shows a Path to opportunity checklist (with Set capacity rating) or a green Ready for opportunity bar, and Create opportunity becomes the main button when ready. The spoken overview no longer stops after the Contact stage. After each stage Grok asks "Shall I go on to the next stage?" and continues on yes. Asking it to go straight through skips the questions.

The demo now follows seven more guide rules. An ask can be planned only in Cultivation. Move to Cultivation? opens a decision: move, or Defer with a reason and an optional Reconsider on date (the prompt returns on that date or after the next substantive interaction). Ask responses are Accepted, Countered, Awaiting and Declined. A declined ask needs a reason and closes the opportunity as Closed Lost. New Record gift (Ask Made, outright gift) and Record payment (Commitment) close the opportunity as Closed Won. The Make the ask reminder is due 7 days before the planned date. Accepted or Countered creates a Follow up on agreed pledge task (due in 10 days, a demo default while the interval is open). How it works and Grok's instructions updated to match.

A substantive meeting needs a next step and its due date unless the outcome is Not interested or Referred elsewhere; an ask meeting needs one unless the investor said no. Grok asks for it and Save is blocked without it. The meeting report gains an Outcome field with the guide's six outcomes, and next-step tasks are filed on the opportunity.
